messages:
ops-jordan: deploy-bot flagged sustained 503s hitting embeddings service (kv-cache) in eu-west1. Need a hotfix deploy, can we fast-track?

deploy-bot: [automated] rc-2025.03.11-kvfix queued for canary in eu-west1. Planned rollout: 10% -> 50% -> 100%. Auto-rollback if 5xx > 1% across window. ETA ~2m.

alex: I can run the deploy. it's an image bump + config tweak (backpressure threshold). no DB changes.

maria: Oncall +1 from me — errors are high, we should move quickly. I'd prefer skip long canary, but willing to let you run a fast canary first.

sam: prefer controlled canary: 10% -> 50% -> 100% with accelerated timing. health checks: /health ok, 95th latency, 5xx rate. If 5xx > 0.5% for 2 consecutive 1-min windows we rollback.

ops-jordan: Need explicit signoff to expedite. @maria can you approve skip or accelerated path? Also we need release note line and a changelog PR link before final.

maria: +1 to accelerated path. I'll standby to trigger rollback if we see regression. release note: 'kv-cache fix: backpressure threshold tweak to reduce 503s'.

release-bot: Draft release note created: https://git.redwood/release/rc-2025.03.11-kvfix. Please append impact, rollback steps.

alex: Deploy command I'll run: `deploy --service embeddings --image rc-2025.03.11-kvfix --region eu-west1 --traffic 10` I'll push canary and watch logs.

ops-jordan: tagging monitoring: @sam you're on watch for metrics (5xx, latency, saturation). If thresholds hit, call rollback.

sam: watching dashboards now. I'll open a rollback ticket pre-filled so we can revert quickly if needed.

sam: rollback ticket created: https://tickets/ROLL-3456 - prefilled revert to rc-2025.03.10, steps included.

deploy-bot: deploy started by alex at 1738887785. Canary 10% applied. Health snapshot: latency 80ms p95, 5xx 0.2%.

alex: canary stable after 2m at 10%. advancing to 50%.

deploy-bot: traffic moved to 50% at 1738887806. Health: p95 85ms, 5xx 0.1%. No errors spike.

maria: dashboards look clean. I'm good to proceed to 100%.

alex: advancing to 100% now.

deploy-bot: full rollout complete at 1738887820. No rollback triggered. Marking deploy successful.

ops-jordan: Thanks team. Final release note to publish: 'hotfix: kv-cache backpressure threshold adjusted to mitigate 503 spikes in eu-west1. Rollback: revert image to rc-2025.03.10 (ticket ROLL-3456)'. I'll merge changelog and close the loop.

maria: :rocket: Good job all. I'll keep monitoring for +30m then close the incident ticket.
